svg.text: off by default · streamed radio, nothing bundled · silent on every failure
buffer full -> the CUE IS DROPPED
a missed sound is never worth a dropped frame
one owned goroutine, stopped by ctx
not an error · not a banner · not a nag
said ONCE, in Z-09 Settings, and never again
WHY it is unavailable — Z-09 says which
over SSH -> the sound would play on the wrong machine
it does not hold a gain of zero

STREAMED, NEVER BUNDLED. Music is internet radio the player chooses; nothing ships in the binary, so there is nothing to license. The two channels differ: interface FX are WORKS (local, always), radio NEEDS THE NETWORK and stops offline.
The default BUILD contains NullAudio and stays pure Go, so the cross-compile matrix survives and the silent path is the one every test run exercises. The real player sits behind a build tag.
FLOW - THE AUDIO SUBSYSTEM AND ITS DEGRADE LADDER
Audio ships in Phase 1: streamed radio, local FX. Cannot fail or block.
